Version 17.0.0

- Updated audit summary write-back paths: audits now save to `memory/seo-geo/optimize/on-page-seo-auditor/` for improved data consistency.
- Metadata version updated to reflect 17.0.0.
- Removed redundant or deprecated file: `skill-card.md` no longer included in the package.
- Minor clarifications in documentation; no impact on user-facing audit steps or features.

on-page-seo-auditor v16.0.0

- Updated version number and metadata from 14.0.0 to 16.0.0 in SKILL.md.
- No major logic or feature changes; documentation and metadata refresh only.

on-page-seo-auditor v14.0.0

- Updated metadata fields: changed the skill slug from "aaron-on-page-seo-auditor" to "on-page-seo-auditor" and incremented the version to 14.0.0.
- SKILL.md edited to reflect the new metadata; internal references updated.
- Removed deprecated file: skill-card.md.

Version 13.0.0 — Major refactor for precision, separation of concerns, and improved integration.

- Skill now focuses strictly on structural on-page SEO elements (titles, meta, headers, keyword use, links, images); E-E-A-T and content quality scoring moved to a separate skill.
- Improved instructions for metric labeling: all scores must now state whether they are measured, user-provided, or estimated—invented/guessed metrics are not allowed.
- New data source helpers and JS-render fallback instructions added for modern rendered sites.
- Clarified routing for tasks: E-E-A-T/content audits and technical SEO (CWV/indexing/crawl) are now explicitly delegated to other specialist skills.
- Skill manifest updated: added “slug”, “displayName”, emoji, and markdown doc links; removed deprecated or redundant fields.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md.

**Major update with scoring improvements and new audit resources:**

- Added sample audit templates and example references to guide users ([audit-example.md], [audit-templates.md]).
- Expanded tags and compatibility metadata for broader marketplace and integration support.
- Clarified and slightly expanded the audit instructions, especially for content quality and audit output options.
- Added an explicit allowed-tools field (“WebFetch”) and outlined optional integration support.
- Updated version to 3.0.0 to reflect substantial skill enhancements.

**Major update with added trigger phrases and enhanced discoverability.**

- Added explicit trigger phrases to the skill for common SEO audit queries (e.g., “audit page SEO”, “SEO score”, “why isn’t this page ranking”).
- Expanded and clarified the skill description; now also suggests using related skills for technical or full EEAT audits.
- Introduced metadata including author, tags for searchability, and version info.
- Provided direct links to the author’s full SEO & GEO skills library for easier discovery.
- No change to audit methodology or step-by-step audit outputs.

- Added a new scoring rubric reference document for more structured audit evaluations.
- Updated and simplified SKILL.md: removed the version field, added a geo-relevance field, and made minor content adjustments.
- No changes to audit functionality or coverage.

- Added explicit version field and set version to "1.0".
- No functional or usage changes; documentation and audit instructions remain unchanged.
- Updated metadata for clearer version tracking.

Initial release — comprehensive on-page SEO auditing skill.

- Performs detailed analysis of title tags, meta descriptions, header structure, content quality, keyword usage, internal linking, image optimization, and technical factors.
- Provides actionable, structured recommendations for each on-page element with scoring and improvement suggestions.
- Supports both automated (with connectors) and manual audits using user-provided data.
- Includes templates and clear instructions to guide SEO audit workflows for single pages, competitor comparisons, and pre-publish checks.
- Outputs findings in a standardized format for easy review and implementation.
